import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluedClass
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionEnlargement
import Lean.LibrarySuggestions.Basic

/-!
# The universal model class on a common Galois-stage carrier

The finite-stage universal classes and the triple-transition maps are enlarged
to one field Galois over the original field. The resulting compatible chart
classes glue on that stage's actual carrier, retaining their comparison with
the ambient universal classes.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

-- This tensor signature uses the same suggestion-index exclusion as the chart gluer.
run_cmd Lean.modifyEnv fun env => Lean.LibrarySuggestions.nameDenyListExt.addEntry env
  "exists_pic0FiniteStageGaloisGluedModelClass"

universe u

open CategoryTheory
open scoped TensorProduct MonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

variable {F K : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
  [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] [IsSepClosed K] [IsGalois F K]
  (Ck : Over (Spec (.of K))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom]
  [IsProper Ck.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom]
  (E : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext Ck F)
  (CM : Over (Spec (.of E.models.M.1))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 CM.hom]
  [IsProper CM.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible CM.hom]

private local instance galoisModelTower : IsScalarTower F E.models.M.1 K :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl

private local instance galoisStageTower (S : DatG0.FiniteStageData E.models.M.1 K) :
    IsScalarTower F E.models.M.1 S.stage :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
-- Specializing the chart gluer to the common enlarged stage exceeds 200k.
/-- The actual enlarged Galois-stage carrier carries a class whose restriction
to each model chart recovers the pinned universal class after scalar extension. -/
theorem exists_pic0FiniteStageGaloisGluedModelClass
    (i : (baseChange E.models.M.1 K).obj CM ≅ Ck) :
    ∃ (S : DatG0.FiniteStageData E.models.M.1 K)
      (h : E.triple.N.1 ≤ S.stage), FiniteDimensional F S.stage ∧ IsGalois F S.stage ∧
      let P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F := ⟨E.enlarge Ck S.toFinSubext h⟩
      @Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage.HasModelClassWithComparison
        F K _ _ _ _ _ Ck _ _ _ P CM
        (inferInstance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 CM.hom)
        (inferInstance : IsProper CM.hom) (inferInstance : GeometricallyIrreducible CM.hom)
        (fun U => overSpec E.models.M.1
          (CommAlgCat.of E.models.M.1 K ⊗
            pic0FiniteStageModelAlgebra Ck E.models (Sum.inl U) : CommAlgCat E.models.M.1))
        (fun U => Over.overSpecMap (CommAlgCat.ofHom S.inclusion ▷
          pic0FiniteStageModelAlgebra Ck E.models (Sum.inl U)).hom)
        (fun U => pic0FiniteStageUniversalModelClass Ck E.models CM i (Sum.inl U)) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional F E.models.L.1 := E.models.L.2
  letI : FiniteDimensional E.models.L.1 E.models.M.1 := E.models.M.2
  letI : FiniteDimensional F E.models.M.1 :=
    FiniteDimensional.trans F E.models.L.1 E.models.M.1
  have H :=
    exists_pic0FiniteStageUniversalModelClass_compatible_isGalois
      (F := F) (K := K) Ck E.models CM i
      (DatG0.FiniteStageData.ofFinSubext E.triple.N)
  rcases H with ⟨S, hS, hG, x, hbc, hx⟩
  letI : FiniteDimensional E.models.M.1 S.stage := S.finiteWitness
  have hfin : FiniteDimensional F S.stage :=
    FiniteDimensional.trans F E.models.M.1 S.stage
  refine ⟨S, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨hS, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨hfin, hG, ?_⟩
  let P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F := ⟨E.enlarge Ck S.toFinSubext hS⟩
  exact @Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage.exists_gluedModelClass_with_comparison
    F K _ _ _ _ _ Ck _ _ _ P CM
    (inferInstance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 CM.hom)
    (inferInstance : IsProper CM.hom) (inferInstance : GeometricallyIrreducible CM.hom) x hx
    (fun U => overSpec E.models.M.1
      (CommAlgCat.of E.models.M.1 K ⊗
        pic0FiniteStageModelAlgebra Ck E.models (Sum.inl U) : CommAlgCat E.models.M.1))
    (fun U => Over.overSpecMap (CommAlgCat.ofHom S.inclusion ▷
      pic0FiniteStageModelAlgebra Ck E.models (Sum.inl U)).hom)
    (fun U => pic0FiniteStageUniversalModelClass Ck E.models CM i (Sum.inl U))
    (fun U => hbc (Sum.inl U))

end

end AlgebraicGeometry
